milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task where the player must locate and observe the spruce sign. The sign is at spawn-relative (3, 0, 2). The player must be within 16 blocks and facing toward the sign (within 45 degrees). Facing tolerance reduced from 60° to 45° per ValidatorAgent's analysis: the sign is at ~56° off the player's initial south-facing direction (yaw=0), so 60° tolerance would allow trivial satisfaction at spawn without any player action. With 45° tolerance, the player must actively turn toward the sign.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task where the player must navigate to the stone hut and observe the black bed inside. The bed center is at spawn-relative (12, 0, 0). A max_distance of 8 is used (tighter than default 16) because the bed is hidden inside an enclosed hut — the player must actually approach the hut and look through the doorway or enter it to see the bed. Facing tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is looking toward the bed when nearby.
